study_identification_part.si4_title: Lifespan Normative Modeling of Brain Microstructure

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Construct a large-scale normative model of white matter microstructure across the lifespan using diffusion MRI, derive centile trajectories by age and sex, and demonstrate clinical utility via anomaly detection and model adaptation in MCI, dementia, and 22q11.2 deletion syndrome.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Large-scale HBR-based normative models of WM microstructure (N=54,583; age 4–91) yield lifespan centile curves and detect clinically meaningful deviations in MCI, dementia, and 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, with robust within-domain and cross-domain validation.
